steps.title: Tool policy per app
steps.what: In one test, editing a policy's tool list down did not change the grant while a broader policy still applied; that was measured in a single configuration.
steps.why: Admins need to know why a change to one policy may not remove access.

steps.title: Policy time window
steps.what: Creating a policy adds its tools to the identity's combined grant.
steps.why: Admins need to know why a change to one policy may not remove access.

steps.title: Gateway log
steps.what: Denied calls look identical to a client, a bare 403, and are told apart only in the gateway log, which distinguishes an identity that is not synced, an app with no policy, and a tool hidden by policy.
steps.why: Admins need to know why a change to one policy may not remove access.

steps.title: Client view of the tool list
steps.what: Tools outside the grant are removed from the tool list before it is returned, so the client cannot tell they exist.
